title: Use a font fallback
summary: A fallback font shows readable words while a web font loads.
introduction: A fallback font shows readable words while a web font loads. Your task: Test the page with a slow font request.
learningObjectives: Test the page with a slow font request.
Explain the example for use a font fallback

blocks.text: A fallback font shows readable words while a web font loads. font-display: swap lets text appear using that fallback.

Use a local test page and browser developer tools. Code samples show a page choice or a measurement. Compare before and after under the same conditions; exact timings depend on the device and network.

blocks.title: Use a font fallback

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `font-display: swap` allows fallback text to appear while the chosen font is still loading.

blocks.text: With a real font file, text can appear in a system font first and switch when ClubText is ready.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Different font shapes can still move text. Choose a similar fallback and measure the page shift.
